responsibility: This header declares the public heap-management interface for the mc-boot runtime. It exports the Modula-2-facing allocation, deallocation, reallocation, and availability procedures that abstract the underlying SysStorage implementation for use by strings, indices, exception blocks, and other runtime data structures.
same_name_distinction: This .h file is the interface half of the GStorage pair: it declares the public Storage_* allocator wrapper API for other mc-boot files, while gcc/m2/mc-boot/GStorage.cc provides the actual forwarding definitions that call SysStorage.
